label: End-of-episode D2: a2 led to S2 after a rewarded S2 trial (low value)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (DELAY_2), and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition. The previous trial must also have reached S2 and been rewarded (prev_reward=1; when the previous trial is outside the window, prev_state is -1 and is allowed). It also only fires in the last ~10 trials of the episode (99% of the mass is in ep_trial 90-99), where the model value head drops below ~4.5-5.2. Every variable is observed at D2, and value is the output of the model itself, so no future variables are used. Alternatives scored on dev: ep_trial>=90 instead of value gave F1 0.67, value<4.5 without the prev_state condition gave F1 0.81, and the recorded predicate gave F1 0.85 with mass recall 0.99. Magnitude: it tends to build over consecutive rewarded a2->S2 trials, so the first such trial in a run is weak or silent, and in example windows it is strongest late in the run. Never fires at D1/GO, on S1, after a1, after an unrewarded previous trial, or before trial ~85.

issues: Systematic false-positive class. The label and predicate say only that the previous trial 'reached S2 and was rewarded' (isin(prev_state,[2,-1])), but the feature needs the previous trial to have been a2->S2 (common), not a1->S2 (rare). Dev, recorded predicate & prev_state==2 & prev_action==1: 430 predicted, precision 0.0. Test, D2 & prev_action==1 & prev_state==2 & prev_reward==1 & action==2 & in_state==2 & ep_trial>=85: 918 predicted, 0 active. So it fires after a rewarded common a2->S2 trial that the agent then repeats (stay with a2), not after any rewarded S2 trial.
Adding the prev_action==2 condition raises test precision from 0.736 to 0.808 with no loss in recall (0.949) or mass recall (0.992). Test F1 goes from 0.829 to 0.873.

Checked and confirmed: it never fires at D1 or GO (0 of 761k steps), never on S1, never after a1, never after prev_reward=0. 99.2% of the mass is in ep_trial 90-99 and 0.8% in 80-89; it is silent before trial 80.

The value<4.5 condition is a proxy for the last ~10 trials of the episode, and it is sharply tuned. Dev F1 is 0.76 at value<4.0, 0.89 at <4.5, 0.80 at <5.0 and 0.76 at <5.2. The explanation's '4.5-5.2' range is loose.
The build-up claim partly holds. When the trial two back was unrewarded (the first rewarded a2->S2 in a run), precision is 0.46, against 0.88 when it was rewarded.

Remaining false positives are concentrated where good==1 (hidden: S1 is now the good state, but a2->S2 keeps getting rewarded). Precision is 0.28 there, but that is only 453 of the 6036 predicted dev steps. This is minor.
